final: WITH profile_stats AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, COUNT(*) as telescope_count, AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bw FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) as mean_avg FROM profile_stats) SELECT p.weathprofile, p.avg_bw, p.telescope_count, p.avg_bw - o.mean_avg as deviation FROM profile_stats p CROSS JOIN overall_mean o WHERE o.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.weathprofile
